profile.title: Technical Architect (.NET) | Application Development | Team Management
profile.tagline: Technical Architect & .NET Lead crafting <primary>high-concurrency microservices, distributed systems</primary> & AI-augmented enterprise solutions.
profile.about: Technical Architect, Senior Full Stack Engineer Lead & AI-Augmented Engineer with over 12+ years of experience building and scaling enterprise web applications and distributed microservices from scratch.

skills.d: Distributed microservices, Saga pattern (Orchestration & Choreography), SOLID principles, and high-concurrency event-driven systems.
Modern .NET (5–9), C#, ASP.NET Core Web API, Blazor Server, Angular (7–10), and React.js with clean UI design systems.
High-throughput messaging with Kafka & RabbitMQ, in-memory caching with Redis, SQL Server, Oracle Cloud, and Dapper/EF Core ORMs.
CI/CD automation, GitHub Actions, Docker, Argo CD, SSO (Keycloak), and AI-augmented engineering with Claude Code, Copilot & Antigravity.

experience.r: Senior Full Stack Developer / Technical Lead
experience.c: Applligent Technologies (Client: Al Sahab National, Riyadh, KSA)
experience.d: Led end-to-end delivery of enterprise solutions for Saudi government entities (SRCA, Ministry of Commerce, MoH) and flagship platforms WAREED & TAQFI. Architected IoT smart traffic signal system with real-time emergency ambulance tracking to trigger automated green corridors. Engineered high-concurrency .NET Core microservices with RabbitMQ, Redis, and multi-database backends.

experience.r: Senior Full Stack Developer / Technical Lead
experience.c: EduSuite Solutions (Client: Al Sahab National, Riyadh, KSA)
experience.d: Engineered high-concurrency microservices in .NET Core utilizing RabbitMQ, Redis, Saga pattern, and multi-database architectures (SQL Server, Oracle Cloud). Managed multi-environment zero-downtime releases and led Agile/Scrum sprint planning and QA coordination.

Directed backend architecture and delivery for cruise-industry enterprise products including SeaRoster, JB Cruise, and Plexus Blazor app using .NET Web APIs, React.js, Blazor, and Dapper ORM. Mentored and guided engineers in enterprise design patterns.

Led migration of enterprise applications from legacy .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 5, redesigning core modules with Web API, React.js, and SQL Server 2019. Authored comprehensive target-state architecture diagrams, database designs, API specifications, and established DevOps continuous delivery standards.

Owned full SDLC execution and system architecture across 18+ internal ERP modules (HR, Outdoor, Accounts, Marketing). Optimized SQL query execution, directed production support, and implemented enterprise SSRS/RDLC reporting.

Delivered full-cycle web and mobile solutions across manufacturing, slot dispatch systems, e-commerce, and enterprise clients. Built reusable framework components adopted as company-wide engineering standards.
